lines.trans: Well done, he looks like him! Congratulations.
And did you not think to shave the moustache?
Then he would have looked completely alike.
Vika, wait! I will not let you go until you believe me.

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

examples.text: А что вы делаете? Руки бреете?
examples.trans: And what are you doing? Shaving your arms?

meanings.note: with a past-tense verb: я бы подумал = I would think
wishes: купили бы = we could have bought

examples.text: Я бы на твоём месте подумал.
examples.trans: If I were you, I'd think about it.

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
Present есть; у меня есть = I have.

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?
Arkady Borisovich, who are your rivals?
All right, here you go. There, look.

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

examples.text: Настроение у меня действительно очень хорошее.
examples.trans: My mood really is very good.
This is indeed an important question.

meanings.note: на днях = in the next few days, or the other day

examples.trans: I'll call in the next few days.
Any day now, on the website.

meanings.en: to guess, to work out, to think of

examples.trans: Why didn't I think of it at once!

examples.text: Какой глупый человек догадался это сделать?
examples.trans: What foolish person thought of doing that?

examples.text: Ты никогда сам не догадаешься об этом.
examples.trans: You will never guess this by yourself.

examples.text: А ты иди домой и делай уроки.
examples.trans: And you go home and do your homework.

examples.text: Так, мы идём к слепым. А ты иди домой и делай уроки.
examples.trans: Right, we're going to the blind people. And you go home and do your homework.

затянуться.gloss: to drag on; to be tightened

meanings.en: to drag on, to last too long
to take a drag (on a cigarette)

examples.trans: The meeting dragged on until evening.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?

meanings.note: To run for a second term.

examples.trans: He is running for a second term.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.
Is that a new look? A moustache?
It's important to him to keep up his image.
I'm shooting a new music video.

examples.text: Мы посмотрели новый клип этой группы.
examples.trans: We watched this band's new music video.

meanings.note: praise, said to a man, woman or child

examples.trans: I see, I see, you're a hero. Well done.

meanings.note: adult male; declines like a feminine -а noun

examples.text: У мужчины бывает не только жена.
examples.trans: A man can have more than just a wife.
This man is waiting for you.

examples.text: У мужчины, мальчик, бывает не только жена. Это моя девушка.
examples.trans: A man, my boy, can have more than just a wife. She's my girlfriend.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.text: Ну что, довольна? Теперь новую работу искать.
examples.trans: Well, happy now? Now I have to look for a new job.

meanings.note: + dative of the person: поверить ему

examples.text: Со своего телефона? И все поверили?
examples.trans: From your own phone? And everyone believed it?

examples.text: Подожди, Нин, ты не поняла. Это же стыдно!
examples.trans: Wait, Nina, you don't get it. It's shameful!

meanings.note: usually short form похож/похожа/похожи + на + accusative

examples.trans: He looks very much like his father.

examples.text: Нормально у вас тут, просторно. И маскировка хорошая, на дворников похожи.
examples.trans: It's nice in here, roomy. And good disguises—you look like janitors.
What do you mean? Where is Mishkin?

сниматься.gloss: to be filmed, act; to come off

meanings.en: to be filmed, to act (in a film, ad)

examples.text: Дима, это тебе не в рекламе сниматься!
examples.trans: Dima, this isn't like acting in a commercial!

examples.text: Кажется, оно застряло и совсем не снимается с пальца!
examples.trans: Looks like it's stuck and won't come off my finger at all!

examples.text: Я совсем не это хочу сказать.
examples.trans: That's not what I mean at all.

examples.text: Нет, Вика, я совсем не это хочу сказать.
examples.trans: No, Vika, that's not what I mean at all.

examples.text: Аркадий Борисович, ну что же вы делаете? Прекратите этот спектакль!
examples.trans: Arkady Borisovich, what are you doing? Stop this performance!

examples.text: Я не хочу играть в этот дешёвый спектакль.
examples.trans: I do not want to play in this cheap performance.

examples.text: Я тебе тогда сказал: ты меня ещё поцелуешь.
examples.trans: I told you back then: you'll kiss me one day.

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

examples.trans: Why did you grow a moustache, Lyova?

examples.text: Когда ты нервничаешь, у тебя ус дёргается.
examples.trans: When you're nervous, your moustache twitches.

examples.text: Лёва, ты с усами так поумнел!
examples.trans: Lyova, you look so much smarter with a moustache!

examples.text: Какое хорошее утро! Лидия Алексеевна, чашку кофе, пожалуйста.
examples.trans: What a lovely morning! Lidia Alekseyevna, a cup of coffee, please.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
